integrity: The primary 2025 publisher PDF was inspected at the exact Proposition 3.1 assumptions, all twelve examples, and the four tabulated concordance subfamilies. The author-uploaded full text of the 2010 Metrika quadratic-section paper was inspected at its characterization and Kendall/Spearman ratio corollary; the 2008 open article and the 2011 full arXiv text were compared for broader coverage. The proof of the source-specific logarithmic obstacle and sharpness is analytic; the bundled checker verifies algebra and numerical convergence. The upper-endpoint continuity needed for a genuine copula was separately checked and built into the final scope. An official 2025 conference abstract book for the February 20–22 meeting publicly discloses the same formula and authors before the 28 October journal publication. The first_public_date records the earliest date in that published conference interval; the precise PDF upload day and individual presentation day are not established.
scientific_limitations: The negative-concordance cutoff applies only to the derivative-constrained asymmetric copula scheme, not to arbitrary asymmetric or quadratic-section copulas.
The sharp lower bound is an infimum, not attained by any interior-differentiable tuning function.
The Spearman–Kendall linear ratio is an established broader quadratic-section property; the new result is the sharp restriction and explicit approach family.

A genuine copula requires the tuning function to be continuous at the upper endpoint; the written interior derivative conditions alone do not enforce this. The theorem explicitly restricts to continuous copulas.
The conference abstract predates the journal version, but the conference book provides an event date interval rather than a separately verified PDF-upload timestamp.
title: Sharp negative concordance envelope for the asymmetric quadratic copula scheme
